newsitem.title: USA: High cotton prices trigger import quota - USDA.
newsitem.headline: High cotton prices trigger import quota - USDA.

text.p: High cotton prices have triggered another special quota permitting entry of 45,207,456 kilograms (99,665,462 lbs), the U.S. Department of Agriculture said Thursday.
The quota, being established on June 2, 1997, applies to cotton purchased not later than Aug 30, 1997 and entered into the United States not later than Nov 28, 1997, USDA said.
The quota amount is for the period Dec 1996 through Feb 1997.
